summary.bn: পানি যত ঘোলা, A পিনের ভোল্টেজ তত কম। পরিষ্কার পানিতে প্রায় ৪.১ ভোল্ট।
summary.en: The cloudier the water, the lower A. About 4.1 V in clean water.

simplified: DFRobot gives about 4.1 V in clean water on a 5 V supply and says the output falls as the water gets cloudier. Their curve of volts against NTU is published only as a picture; the lab uses the formula users report reading from it, NTU = −1120.4 V² + 5742.3 V − 4352.9, from about 4.2 V (clear) to 2.5 V (3000 NTU). It is taken as a share of the supply.
The module's digital output and its switch are not modelled: A is always the analog signal.
Light from outside, bubbles and temperature do not change the reading.
Its output resistance and supply current (up to 40 mA, by DFRobot) are estimates.
